top_signals.title: Data Center Operator AirTrunk Is Said to Delay $1.5 Billion IPO
top_signals.summary: Data center operator AirTrunk is delaying a planned initial public offering of a real estate investment trust in Singapore until next year as higher interest rates and market volatility temper investor demand, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
